issues.failure_explanation: The bound (E-r-unweighted-small) needs exponential smallness of the kernel of E_sigma on the full product Gamma_R x Gamma_R, including the corners. Proposition prop:reflected-kernel-estimate only covers K x Gamma_R and Gamma_R x Gamma_R^int, and the paper's own remark says it fails on all of Gamma_R x Gamma_R. Near a corner, E_sigma contains (1-chi_im(x)chi_im(y)) times the log-singular nearest-image kernel. Since chi_im is not required to equal 1 near the endpoints, this term is generally only O(sigma^{-1/2}) by Lemma lem:endpoint-Hankel, not exponentially small.
